content.short: USDM is a fully regulated, fiat-backed stablecoin on Cardano, always redeemable 1:1 for U.S. Dollars.
content.description: USDM is Cardano's premier regulatory-compliant, fiat-backed stablecoin, developed by Mehen to provide a stable medium of exchange within the ecosystem. Each USDM token is backed 1:1 by US Dollar bank deposits and high-quality money market funds, ensuring that users can always redeem their assets with confidence. As a US-regulated Money Services Business (MSB), the issuer maintains high standards of transparency and compliance with federal and state governing bodies. By providing a reliable bridge between fiat and DeFi, USDM enhances liquidity and reduces volatility across Cardano.
